methodology: Articles sourced from Virginia-specific RSS feeds and Google News RSS, filtered for AI/technology/workforce relevance, then assessed by Claude against the scenario framework. Each article is tagged with the region it most affects and the scenario it signals toward.

signals.title: Norfolk native brings free AI workshops to Hampton Roads to close the technology gap - WTKR
signals.signal_reading: Free AI workshops delivered by a local native to Hampton Roads signal grassroots capability-building outside traditional tech hubs, potentially distributing deep AI literacy through community networks rather than platform dependence.

signals.title: Virginia Tech sets course for human-centered AI leadership - Virginia Tech News
signals.signal_reading: Virginia Tech's institutional AI leadership initiative concentrates research capability and talent development in Blacksburg, creating a knowledge hub that could either radiate outward or reinforce the urban-rural capability gap depending on extension efforts.

signals.title: Camp Welcomes Hampton Roads Youth to Learn About Cybersecurity and AI - Old Dominion University
signals.signal_reading: Youth cybersecurity and AI camps at Old Dominion University signal early-stage capability seeding in Hampton Roads, building foundational literacy outside NoVA that could enable distributed peer learning networks if sustained beyond one-off programs.

signals.title: Roanoke College joins Google AI for Education Accelerator - Roanoke College
signals.signal_reading: Roanoke College's Google AI partnership represents platform-mediated adoption in a non-metro region—broad access through vendor tools but potentially shallow integration that doesn't build independent AI development capacity.

signals.title: How Virginia keeps tabs on cybersecurity threats as AI takes hold - VPM
signals.signal_reading: State-level cybersecurity monitoring centralized in Richmond concentrates AI-adjacent expertise in the capital region, reinforcing government-tech corridor capability while smaller localities lack equivalent threat detection sophistication.
